exposure: Primiparous and multiparous women were analyzed separately for gestational diabetes, instrumental deliveries, and cesareans.
Advanced maternal age (AMA) (categorized as 35-38 years, 39-42 years, and >42 years)
cohort: 3,315 births in the north of Spain in 2014
finding: Advanced maternal age was associated with increased odds of repeated abortions, gestational diabetes (especially in primiparous women), instrumental deliveries, and cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Advanced maternal age was associated with increased odds of instrumental deliveries and cesarean deliveries.
